protocol.task: direct distributions for each of next15 full-minute candle closes from ONE causal snapshot
protocol.horizon_definition: h1 closes at first_target_start+60s; h15 at first_target_start+15*60s; not minutes since click
protocol.tails: unbounded first/last; no clipping or assumed within-bin density
protocol.boundary: upper bounds inclusive except+2 goes bullish; aggregate <=-2 / (-2,2) / >=+2
protocol.inputs: same0.4 causal candle/book/trade features once; no generated feedback, future book/trade/candle inputs or invented updates
protocol.cohort: 0.4 origins purged when any15 target spans cross split boundary; all target minute contents valid
protocol.loss: range CE weighted across15 outputs +0.25 h1 candle colour CE
protocol.weights: equal1/15; near_weighted h1=.5 and each h2-15=.5/14
protocol.selection: three-seed mean development equal-average15-horizon26-bin log loss; seed17 fixed; early stop same score
protocol.normalization: reuse0.2/0.4 fit-only scalers; no new outcome-normalized features
protocol.calibration: separate scalar temperature per horizon on calibration only; colour scalar separately; same bounded grid
protocol.baselines: fit-only per-horizon empirical26-bin histogram; fit-quartile past15-minute volatility conditional histograms; add-one smoothing
protocol.evaluation: per-horizon range log loss, ordinal RPS, direction, reliability, bin coverage, daily results; matched h1 comparison collapsed18 bins vs0.4
limitations: Marginal forecast columns are not a joint path distribution or target-before-stop probabilities.
Historical candle availability assumed and provider receipt clocks unverified.
October benchmark previously inspected; no prospective model validation or perfect probability claim.
Subsecond events absent from existing source features; future order arrivals remain unknown.
